# CIOs say AI is outpacing governance, Thoughtworks finds

> 来源：https://securitybrief.co.uk/story/cios-say-ai-is-outpacing-governance-thoughtworks-finds（2026-10-26 抓取；C 级：不在 A/B 名单：按 C 级处理；参考：authority=3、站点「SecurityBrief UK」（仅供参考，不影响定级））

## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

The study covered 3,200 CIOs across 10 countries.

The data suggests there is no single model for controlling AI spending.

Among those surveyed, 22% said AI budgets are managed centrally by IT, while another 22% said responsibility is shared between IT and the business.

A further 20% said budgets are controlled independently by business units, 19% said they sit at executive or board level, and 17% said the model is still evolving.

Without a dominant structure for oversight, budgets and leadership, CIOs are left carrying responsibility for operational, compliance and workforce risks even when formal authority sits elsewhere.

Authority over AI is distributed, but accountability hasn't always moved with it.
